title: Supplemental Balance Additions to Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Clause of the client placement terms for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on a client's addition of a supplemental balance, meaning an increase in the same debt, to an account already placed.

## Clause

**1. What may be added.** A client may add to an account only an increase in the same debt, and the reason must be one of the reasons listed below for the account's debt type. A new debt is always placed as its own account.

**2. Window.** A supplemental balance is accepted only when the handling date is no later than the last day of the supplemental window counted from the date the account was placed. The window is the stage's supplemental window in calendar days, the day after the placement date being day one and the last day included.

**3. Account status.** A supplemental balance is accepted only on an account whose status is placed, validation period, active, arranged or hardship hold.

**4. Count and amount caps.** The addition is refused when the number of supplemental additions already on the account equals the stage's maximum number of supplemental additions, or when the supplemental additions already on the account plus this addition would exceed the stage's cumulative cap percentage of the placed balance. The cap in dollars is the placed balance multiplied by that percentage and divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent; the room still open is that cap less the supplemental additions already on the account.

**5. Effect on arrangements.** An accepted addition never changes an existing settlement amount or an active payment plan's total; the added amount stays owed on the account after the arrangement is completed.

## Reasons accepted by debt type

| Debt type | Supplemental reasons accepted |
|---|---|
| Medical | Insurance denial rebill; billing correction increase |
| Bank card | Billing correction increase |
| Utility | Final bill true-up; billing correction increase |
| Telecom | Unreturned equipment charge; billing correction increase |
| Auto deficiency | Billing correction increase |
| Private student loan | Billing correction increase |
| Retail installment | Billing correction increase |

## Hypothetical cases

*The stage figures are the Primary Placement figures of the Placed Consumer Accounts supplemental schedule (60-day window, at most 2 additions, 25% cap); account details are invented.*

**Window boundary.** An account placed on 2026-03-02 has day one on 2026-03-03 and day 60 on 2026-05-01. An addition handled on 2026-05-01 is inside the window; one handled on 2026-05-02 is outside it.

**Amount cap.** Placed balance $1200.00: the cap is $1200.00 multiplied by 25 and divided by one hundred, that is $300.00. With one earlier addition of $180.00 on file, the room still open is $120.00.

| Proposed addition | Additions on file after it | Count after it | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| $120.00 | $300.00 (does not exceed $300.00) | 2 | Accepted |
| $120.01 | $300.01 (exceeds $300.00) | 2 | Refused |

After two additions, a third is refused at Primary Placement whatever its amount, because the count already equals the stage maximum.

**Reason check.** A utility client may add a final bill true-up; a bank-card client may not, because the only reason listed for a bank-card debt is a billing correction increase.
